concerns.text: T015 (Power Analysis) is listed AFTER T013 (Search Metabolomics Workbench) and T014 (Verify pairing feasibility). Power analysis (T009/T015) determines the minimum required sample size (n>=28) to proceed. If T015 fails, the project must abort. Placing T015 after T013/T014 creates a risk of executing expensive data searches and pairing logic before confirming the dataset meets the statistical power requirement. T015 must precede T013/T014 or be the immediate gate after T011/T012.

T024 (Create expression CSV) and T025 (Create metabolite CSV) are marked 'Conditional on T027 passing'. However, T027 (Validate pairing rate) requires the existence of the paired data to calculate the rate. T023 (Implement pairing logic) produces the paired data. The dependency chain is T023 -> T027 -> T024/T025. The current text implies T024/T025 might be attempted before T027, or the condition is ambiguous. Explicitly state T024/T025 depend on T027's success, and T027 depends on T023's output.

T040 (Implement species-specific z-score normalization) is marked 'After T036' (Create FeatureSet output matrix). However, T041 (ComBat batch correction) is listed immediately after T040. FR-010 requires 'species-specific z-score normalization AND ComBat batch correction'. The order is critical: Z-score must be applied per species BEFORE ComBat (which corrects batch effects across species). The current list order (T040 then T041) is correct, but T040's dependency on T036 is correct only if T036 produces the raw feature matrix. Ensure T036 is the producer of the matrix consumed by T040.

T047 (Permutation test) is marked 'Depends on T045' (Ridge Regression training). This is correct. However, T048 (Report p-value) and T049 (Bonferroni correction) are listed after T047. T049 (Correction) must logically depend on T048 (Raw p-values) or T047 (which produces raw p-values). The current flow T047 -> T048 -> T049 is acceptable, but T048's description 'Report two-sided p-value' implies it consumes T047's output. Ensure T048 explicitly consumes T047's raw p-values, and T049 consumes T048's output (or T047's if T048 is just reporting).

T028 (Verify checksums) is marked '[~]' (incomplete) and placed after T027. SC-004 requires checksum verification for >=99% of downloaded files. This check should ideally happen immediately after download (T021/T022) or as a prerequisite to pairing (T023). Placing it after pairing (T027) delays the detection of corrupted data until after expensive pairing logic has run. Recommend moving T028 to follow T021/T022 directly.
